058    public static String getModififerKML(String id,
059            String name,
060            String description,
061            String symbolCode,
062            String controlPoints,
063            Double scale,
064            String bbox,
065            SparseArray symbolModifiers,
066            SparseArray symbolAttributes,
067            int format, int symStd) {
068        String output = "";
069        List<String> placemarks = new LinkedList<String>();
070
071        try {
072            double maxAlt = 0;
073            double minAlt = 0;
074
075            output = RenderSymbol(id, name, description, symbolCode, controlPoints, scale, bbox, symbolModifiers, symbolAttributes, format, symStd);
076            int pmiStart = output.indexOf("<Placemark");
077            int pmiEnd = 0;
078            int curr = 0;
079            int count = 0;
080            String tempPlacemark = "";
081            while (pmiStart > 0) {
082                if (count > 0) {
083                    pmiEnd = output.indexOf("</Placemark>", pmiStart) + 12;
084                    tempPlacemark = output.substring(pmiStart, pmiEnd);
085
086                    if (tempPlacemark.contains("<Point>")) {
087                        placemarks.add(output.substring(pmiStart, pmiEnd));
088                    }
089                    //System.out.println(placemarks.get(count));
090                    //end, check for more
091                    pmiStart = output.indexOf("<Placemark", pmiEnd - 2);
092                }
093                count++;
094            }
095            java.lang.StringBuilder sb = new java.lang.StringBuilder();
096            for (String pm : placemarks) {
097                sb.append(pm);
098            }
099            return sb.toString();
100        } catch (Exception exc) {
101
102        }
103
104        return output;
105    }

107    /**
108     * GE has the unusual distinction of being an application with coordinates
109     * outside its own extents. It appears to only be a problem when lines cross
110     * the IDL
111     *
112     * @param pts2d the client points
113     */
114    public static void NormalizeGECoordsToGEExtents(double leftLongitude,
115            double rightLongitude,
116            ArrayList<Point2D> pts2d) {
117        try {
118            int j = 0;
119            double x = 0, y = 0;
120            Point2D pt2d = null;
121            int n = pts2d.size();
122            //for (j = 0; j < pts2d.size(); j++) 
123            for (j = 0; j < n; j++) {
124                pt2d = pts2d.get(j);
125                x = pt2d.getX();
126                y = pt2d.getY();
127                while (x < leftLongitude) {
128                    x += 360;
129                }
130                while (x > rightLongitude) {
131                    x -= 360;
132                }
133
134                pt2d = new Point2D.Double(x, y);
135                pts2d.set(j, pt2d);
136            }
137        } catch (Exception exc) {
138        }
139    }
140
141    /**
142     * GE recognizes coordinates in the range of -180 to +180
143     *
144     * @param pt2d
145     * @return
146     */
147    protected static Point2D NormalizeCoordToGECoord(Point2D pt2d) {
148        Point2D ptGeo = null;
149        try {
150            double x = pt2d.getX(), y = pt2d.getY();
151            while (x < -180) {
152                x += 360;
153            }
154            while (x > 180) {
155                x -= 360;
156            }
157
158            ptGeo = new Point2D.Double(x, y);
159        } catch (Exception exc) {
160        }
161        return ptGeo;
162    }

164    /**
165     * We have to ensure the bounding rectangle at least includes the symbol or
166     * there are problems rendering, especially when the symbol crosses the IDL
167     *
168     * @param controlPoints the client symbol anchor points
169     * @param bbox the original bounding box
170     * @return the modified bounding box
171     */
172    private static String getBoundingRectangle(String controlPoints,
173            String bbox) {
174        String bbox2 = "";
175        try {
176            //first get the minimum bounding rect for the geo coords
177            Double left = 0.0;
178            Double right = 0.0;
179            Double top = 0.0;
180            Double bottom = 0.0;
181
182            String[] coordinates = controlPoints.split(" ");
183            int len = coordinates.length;
184            int i = 0;
185            left = Double.MAX_VALUE;
186            right = -Double.MAX_VALUE;
187            top = -Double.MAX_VALUE;
188            bottom = Double.MAX_VALUE;
189            for (i = 0; i < len; i++) {
190                String[] coordPair = coordinates[i].split(",");
191                Double latitude = Double.valueOf(coordPair[1].trim());
192                Double longitude = Double.valueOf(coordPair[0].trim());
193                if (longitude < left) {
194                    left = longitude;
195                }
196                if (longitude > right) {
197                    right = longitude;
198                }
199                if (latitude > top) {
200                    top = latitude;
201                }
202                if (latitude < bottom) {
203                    bottom = latitude;
204                }
205            }
206            bbox2 = left.toString() + "," + bottom.toString() + "," + right.toString() + "," + top.toString();
207        } catch (Exception ex) {
208            System.out.println("Failed to create bounding rectangle in MultiPointHandler.getBoundingRect");
209        }
210        return bbox2;
211    }

213    /**
214     * need to use the symbol to get the upper left control point in order to
215     * produce a valid PointConverter
216     *
217     * @param geoCoords
218     * @return
219     */
220    private static Point2D getControlPoint(ArrayList<Point2D> geoCoords) {
221        Point2D pt2d = null;
222        try {
223            double left = Double.MAX_VALUE;
224            double right = -Double.MAX_VALUE;
225            double top = -Double.MAX_VALUE;
226            double bottom = Double.MAX_VALUE;
227            Point2D ptTemp = null;
228            int n = geoCoords.size();
229            //for (int j = 0; j < geoCoords.size(); j++) 
230            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
231                ptTemp = geoCoords.get(j);
232                if (ptTemp.getX() < left) {
233                    left = ptTemp.getX();
234                }
235                if (ptTemp.getX() > right) {
236                    right = ptTemp.getX();
237                }
238                if (ptTemp.getY() > top) {
239                    top = ptTemp.getY();
240                }
241                if (ptTemp.getY() < bottom) {
242                    bottom = ptTemp.getY();
243                }
244            }
245            pt2d = new Point2D.Double(left, top);
246        } catch (Exception ex) {
247            System.out.println("Failed to create control point in MultiPointHandler.getControlPoint");
248        }
249        return pt2d;
250    }

252    /**
253     * Assumes a reference in which the north pole is on top.
254     *
255     * @param geoCoords the geographic coordinates
256     * @return the upper left corner of the MBR containing the geographic
257     * coordinates
258     */
259    private static Point2D getGeoUL(ArrayList<Point2D> geoCoords) {
260        Point2D ptGeo = null;
261        try {
262            int j = 0;
263            Point2D pt = null;
264            double left = geoCoords.get(0).getX();
265            double top = geoCoords.get(0).getY();
266            double right = geoCoords.get(0).getX();
267            double bottom = geoCoords.get(0).getY();
268            int n = geoCoords.size();
269            //for (j = 1; j < geoCoords.size(); j++) 
270            for (j = 1; j < n; j++) {
271                pt = geoCoords.get(j);
272                if (pt.getX() < left) {
273                    left = pt.getX();
274                }
275                if (pt.getX() > right) {
276                    right = pt.getX();
277                }
278                if (pt.getY() > top) {
279                    top = pt.getY();
280                }
281                if (pt.getY() < bottom) {
282                    bottom = pt.getY();
283                }
284            }
285            //if geoCoords crosses the IDL
286            if (right - left > 180) {
287                //There must be at least one x value on either side of +/-180. Also, there is at least
288                //one positive value to the left of +/-180 and negative x value to the right of +/-180.
289                //We are using the orientation with the north pole on top so we can keep
290                //the existing value for top. Then the left value will be the least positive x value
291                //left = geoCoords.get(0).getX();
292                left = 180;
293                //for (j = 1; j < geoCoords.size(); j++) 
294                n = geoCoords.size();
295                for (j = 0; j < n; j++) {
296                    pt = geoCoords.get(j);
297                    if (pt.getX() > 0 && pt.getX() < left) {
298                        left = pt.getX();
299                    }
300                }
301            }
302            ptGeo = new Point2D.Double(left, top);
303        } catch (Exception ex) {
304            System.out.println("Failed to create control point in MultiPointHandler.getControlPoint");
305        }
306        return ptGeo;
307    }
308    private static String getBboxFromCoords(ArrayList<Point2D> geoCoords) {
309        //var ptGeo = null;
310        String bbox = null;
311        try {
312            int j = 0;
313            Point2D pt = null;
314            double left = geoCoords.get(0).getX();
315            double top = geoCoords.get(0).getY();
316            double right = geoCoords.get(0).getX();
317            double bottom = geoCoords.get(0).getY();
318            for (j = 1; j < geoCoords.size(); j++) {
319                pt = geoCoords.get(j);
320                if (pt.getX() < left) {
321                    left = pt.getX();
322                }
323                if (pt.getX() > right) {
324                    right = pt.getX();
325                }
326                if (pt.getY() > top) {
327                    top = pt.getY();
328                }
329                if (pt.getY() < bottom) {
330                    bottom = pt.getY();
331                }
332            }
333            //if geoCoords crosses the IDL
334            if (right - left > 180) {
335                //There must be at least one x value on either side of +/-180. Also, there is at least
336                //one positive value to the left of +/-180 and negative x value to the right of +/-180.
337                //We are using the orientation with the north pole on top so we can keep
338                //the existing value for top. Then the left value will be the least positive x value
339                //left = geoCoords[0].x;
340                left = 180;
341                right = -180;
342                for (j = 0; j < geoCoords.size(); j++) {
343                    pt = geoCoords.get(j);
344                    if (pt.getX() > 0 && pt.getX() < left) {
345                        left = pt.getX();
346                    }
347                    if (pt.getX() < 0 && pt.getX() > right) {
348                        right = pt.getX();
349                    }
350                }
351            }
352            //ptGeo = new armyc2.c2sd.graphics2d.Point2D(left, top);
353            bbox = Double.toString(left) + "," + Double.toString(bottom) + "," + Double.toString(right) + "," + Double.toString(top);
354        } catch (Exception ex) {
355            System.out.println("Failed to create control point in MultiPointHandler.getBboxFromCoords");
356        }
357        //return ptGeo;            
358        return bbox;
359    }

361    private static boolean crossesIDL(ArrayList<Point2D> geoCoords) {
362        boolean result = false;
363        Point2D pt2d = getControlPoint(geoCoords);
364        double left = pt2d.getX();
365        Point2D ptTemp = null;
366        int n = geoCoords.size();
367        //for (int j = 0; j < geoCoords.size(); j++) 
368        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
369            ptTemp = geoCoords.get(j);
370            if (Math.abs(ptTemp.getX() - left) > 180) {
371                return true;
372            }
373        }
374        return result;
375    }

509    /**
510     * Assumes bbox is of form left, right, bottom, top and it is currently only
511     * using the width to calculate a reasonable scale. If the original scale is
512     * within the max and min range it returns the original scale.
513     *
514     * @param bbox
515     * @param origScale
516     * @return
517     */
518    private static double getReasonableScale(String bbox, double origScale) {
519        double scale = origScale;
520        try {
521            String[] bounds = bbox.split(",");
522            double left = Double.valueOf(bounds[0]);
523            double right = Double.valueOf(bounds[2]);
524            double top = Double.valueOf(bounds[3]);
525            double bottom = Double.valueOf(bounds[1]);
526            //return a somewhat arbitrary scale value for unreasonable extents, i.e. 1000 is typical
527            //earth circumference/2 meters * 39.3701 inches/meter * 96 pixels/inch * 1000 pixels wide
528            //features will shrink as the globe gets shrinks less than 1000 pixels across
529            if (left == -180 && right == 180) {
530                return 7.573e7; //was origScale
531            } else if (left == 180 && right == -180) {
532                return 7.573e7; //was origScale
533            }
534            POINT2 ul = new POINT2(left, top);
535            POINT2 ur = new POINT2(right, top);
536            POINT2 lr = new POINT2(right, bottom);
537            //double widthInMeters = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_distance(ul, ur, null, null);
538            double widthInMeters = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_distance(ul, lr, null, null);
539            double maxWidthInPixels = _maxPixelWidth;
540            double minScale = (maxWidthInPixels / widthInMeters) * (1.0d / 96.0d) * (1.0d / 39.37d);
541            minScale = 1.0d / minScale;
542            if (origScale < minScale) {
543                return minScale;
544            }
545
546            double minWidthInPixels = _minPixelWidth;
547            double maxScale = (minWidthInPixels / widthInMeters) * (1.0d / 96.0d) * (1.0d / 39.37d);
548            maxScale = 1.0d / maxScale;
549            if (origScale > maxScale) {
550                return maxScale;
551            }
552        } catch (NumberFormatException exc) {
553        }
554        return scale;
555    }

951    private static boolean getBasicShapes(MilStdSymbol milStd,
952            Object clipArea,
953            IPointConversion ipc,
954            int symStd) {
955        //String symbolId=mss.getSymbolID();
956        int linetype = CELineArray.CGetLinetypeFromString(milStd.getSymbolID(), symStd);
957        ArrayList<Double> AM = null;
958        ArrayList<Double> AN = null;
959        double buffer=0,r=0;
960        boolean result = false;
961        switch (linetype) {
962            case TacticalLines.PBS_CIRCLE:
963                AM = milStd.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE);
964                AN = milStd.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AN_AZIMUTH);                
965                if(AM.size()==1)
966                {
967                    r=AM.get(0);
968                    AM.add(r);
969                    buffer=0;
970                    AM.add(buffer);
971                }
972                else if(AM.size()==2)
973                {
974                    r=AM.get(0);
975                    buffer=AM.get(1);
976                    AM.set(1, r);
977                    AM.add(buffer);
978                }
979                else if(AM.size()==3)
980                {
981                    r=AM.get(0);
982                    AM.set(1, r);
983                }
984                result = true;
985                break;
986            case TacticalLines.BS_ELLIPSE:
987            case TacticalLines.PBS_ELLIPSE:
988                AM = milStd.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE);
989                AN = milStd.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AN_AZIMUTH);                
990                if(AM.size()==1)
991                {
992                    r=AM.get(0);
993                    AM.add(r);
994                    buffer=0;
995                    AM.add(buffer);
996                }                
997                if(AM.size()==2)
998                {
999                    AM.add(0d);
1000                }                
1001                result = true;
1002                break;
1003            default:
1004                return false;
1005        }
1006        //there must be an AN array with an element
1007        if (AN == null) {
1008            AN = new ArrayList<Double>();
1009        }
1010        if (AN.isEmpty() ){
1011            AN.add(new Double(0));
1012        }
1013        ArrayList coords = milStd.getCoordinates();
1014        double pivotX = ((Point2D.Double) coords.get(0)).x;
1015        double pivotY = ((Point2D.Double) coords.get(0)).y;
1016        double semiMajor = AM.get(0);
1017        double semiMinor = AM.get(1);
1018        double rotation = AN.get(0);
1019        buffer=AM.get(2);
1020        String strAltitudeMode = milStd.getAltitudeMode();
1021        if (strAltitudeMode.isEmpty()) {
1022            strAltitudeMode = "clampToGround";
1023        }
1024        KmlOptions.AltitudeMode altitudeMode = KmlOptions.AltitudeMode.fromString(strAltitudeMode);
1025        //get buffer fill shape from JavaRendererServer, pass the GeoPoints
1026        ArrayList<GeoPoint> geoPts = XsltCoordinateWrapper.getEllipsePoints(pivotX, pivotY, altitudeMode, semiMajor+buffer, semiMinor+buffer, 0, 0, rotation);
1027        ArrayList<Point2D> coordinates = new ArrayList();
1028        double x = 0, y = 0;
1029        for (int j = 0; j < geoPts.size(); j++) {
1030            x = geoPts.get(j).x;
1031            y = geoPts.get(j).y;
1032            coordinates.add(new Point2D.Double(x, y));
1033        }
1034        milStd.setCoordinates(coordinates);
1035        clsRenderer.render_Shape(milStd, ipc, clipArea, ShapeInfo.SHAPE_TYPE_FILL, null, milStd.getFillColor(), 0);
1036        //get the outline and hatch shapes
1037        ArrayList<GeoPoint> geoPts2 = XsltCoordinateWrapper.getEllipsePoints(pivotX, pivotY, altitudeMode, semiMajor, semiMinor, 0, 0, rotation);
1038        ArrayList<Point2D> coordinates2 = new ArrayList();
1039        for (int j = 0; j < geoPts2.size(); j++) {
1040            x = geoPts2.get(j).x;
1041            y = geoPts2.get(j).y;
1042            coordinates2.add(new Point2D.Double(x, y));
1043        }            
1044        milStd.setCoordinates(coordinates2);
1045        clsRenderer.render_Shape(milStd, ipc, clipArea, ShapeInfo.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE, milStd.getLineColor(), null, milStd.getPatternFillType());
1046        
1047        milStd.setModifierShapes(new ArrayList<ShapeInfo>());
1048        return result;
1049    }

1325

1327                double longitude = geoCoord.getX();
1328                label.setModifierStringPosition(new Point2D.Double(longitude, latitude));
1329
1330            }   
1331
1332            ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
1333            mSymbol.setModifierShapes(modifiers);
1334            mSymbol.setSymbolShapes(shapes);
1335
1336        } catch (Exception exc) {

1340        }

1367    private static ArrayList<ArrayList<Point2D>> ConvertPolylinePixelsToCoords(ArrayList<ArrayList<Point2D>> polylines, IPointConversion ipc, Boolean normalize) {
1368        ArrayList<ArrayList<Point2D>> newPolylines = new ArrayList<ArrayList<Point2D>>();
1369
1370        double latitude = 0;
1371        double longitude = 0;
1372        ArrayList<Point2D> newLine = null;
1373        try {
1374            for (ArrayList<Point2D> line : polylines) {
1375                newLine = new ArrayList<Point2D>();
1376                for (Point2D pt : line) {
1377                    Point2D geoCoord = ipc.PixelsToGeo(pt);
1378
1379                    if (normalize) {
1380                        geoCoord = NormalizeCoordToGECoord(geoCoord);
1381                    }
1382
1383                    latitude = geoCoord.getY();
1384                    longitude = geoCoord.getX();
1385                    newLine.add(new Point2D.Double(longitude, latitude));
1386                }
1387                newPolylines.add(newLine);
1388            }
1389        } catch (Exception exc) {
1390            System.out.println(exc.getMessage());
1391            exc.printStackTrace();
1392        }
1393        return newPolylines;
1394    }

1710    private static Rectangle getOverscanClipBounds(Rectangle rect, IPointConversion ipc) {
1711        if (rect == null)
1712            return null;
1713        double maxWidth = Math.abs(ipc.GeoToPixels(new Point2D.Double(180, 0)).getX() - ipc.GeoToPixels(new Point2D.Double(0, 0)).getX());
1714        double maxHeight = Math.abs(ipc.GeoToPixels(new Point2D.Double(0, 90)).getY() - ipc.GeoToPixels(new Point2D.Double(0, -90)).getY());
1715        double overScanScale = RendererSettings.getInstance().getOverscanScale();
1716        if (rect.width * overScanScale > maxWidth) {
1717            overScanScale = maxWidth / rect.width;
1718        }
1719        if (rect.height * overScanScale > maxHeight) {
1720            overScanScale = maxHeight / rect.height;
1721        }
1722        return new Rectangle((int) (rect.x - (rect.width * (overScanScale - 1)) / 2), (int) (rect.y - (rect.height * (overScanScale - 1)) / 2), (int) (rect.width * overScanScale), (int) (rect.height * overScanScale));
1723    }

1793            Double latitude = Double.valueOf(coordPair[1].trim()).doubleValue();
1794            Double longitude = Double.valueOf(coordPair[0].trim()).doubleValue();
1795            geoCoords.add(new Point2D.Double(longitude, latitude));
1796        }
1797
1798        try {
1799            MilStdSymbol mSymbol = new MilStdSymbol(symbolCode, null, geoCoords, null);
1800
1801            if (symbolModifiers != null && symbolModifiers.equals("") == false) {
1802                populateModifiers(symbolModifiers, symbolAttributes, mSymbol);
1803            } else {
1804                mSymbol.setFillColor(null);
1805            }
1806
1807            clsRenderer.renderWithPolylines(mSymbol, ipc, rect);
1808            shapes = mSymbol.getSymbolShapes();
1809            modifiers = mSymbol.getModifierShapes();
1810
1811            boolean normalize = false;
1812
1813            if (format == 1) {
1814                jsonOutput.append("{\"type\":\"symbol\",");
1815                jsonContent = JSONize(shapes, modifiers, ipc, false, normalize);
1816                jsonOutput.append(jsonContent);
1817                jsonOutput.append("}");
1818            } else if (format == 0) {
1819                String fillColor = null;
1820                if (mSymbol.getFillColor() != null) {
1821                    fillColor = Integer.toHexString(mSymbol.getFillColor().toARGB());//Integer.toHexString(shapeInfo.getFillColor().getRGB()
1822                }
1823                jsonContent = KMLize(id, name, description, symbolCode, shapes, modifiers, ipc, normalize, mSymbol.getLineColor(), mSymbol.get_WasClipped(),mSymbol.isTextScaleSensitive(),mSymbol.isSymbolScaleSensitive());
1824                jsonOutput.append(jsonContent);
1825            }
1826
1827        } catch (Exception exc) {
1828            jsonOutput = new StringBuilder();
1829            jsonOutput.append("{\"type\":\"error\",\"error\":\"There was an error creating the MilStdSymbol " + symbolCode + ": " + "- ");
1830            jsonOutput.append(exc.getMessage() + " - ");
1831            jsonOutput.append("\"}");
1832        }
1833
1834        boolean debug = true;
1835        if (debug == true) {
1836            System.out.println("Symbol Code: " + symbolCode);
1837            System.out.println("BBOX: " + bbox);
1838            if (controlPoints != null) {
1839                System.out.println("Geo Points: " + controlPoints);
1840            }
1841            if (tgl != null && tgl.get_Pixels() != null)//pixels != null
1842            {
1843                //System.out.println("Pixel: " + pixels.toString());
1844                System.out.println("Pixel: " + tgl.get_Pixels().toString());
1845            }
1846            if (bbox != null) {
1847                System.out.println("geo bounds: " + bbox);
1848            }
1849            if (rect != null) {
1850                System.out.println("pixel bounds: " + rect.toString());
1851            }
1852            if (jsonOutput != null) {
1853                System.out.println(jsonOutput.toString());
1854            }
1855        }
1856        return jsonOutput.toString();
1857
1858    }

1860    private static SymbolInfo MilStdSymbolToSymbolInfo(MilStdSymbol symbol) {
1861        SymbolInfo si = null;
1862
1863        ArrayList<TextInfo> tiList = new ArrayList<TextInfo>();
1864        ArrayList<LineInfo> liList = new ArrayList<LineInfo>();
1865
1866        TextInfo tiTemp = null;
1867        LineInfo liTemp = null;
1868        ShapeInfo siTemp = null;
1869
1870        ArrayList<ShapeInfo> lines = symbol.getSymbolShapes();
1871        ArrayList<ShapeInfo> modifiers = symbol.getModifierShapes();
1872
1873        int lineCount = lines.size();
1874        int modifierCount = modifiers.size();
1875        for (int i = 0; i < lineCount; i++) {
1876            siTemp = lines.get(i);
1877            if (siTemp.getPolylines() != null) {
1878                liTemp = new LineInfo();
1879                liTemp.setFillColor(siTemp.getFillColor());
1880                liTemp.setLineColor(siTemp.getLineColor());
1881                liTemp.setPolylines(siTemp.getPolylines());
1882                liTemp.setStroke(siTemp.getStroke());
1883                liList.add(liTemp);
1884            }
1885        }
1886
1887        for (int j = 0; j < modifierCount; j++) {
1888            tiTemp = new TextInfo();
1889            siTemp = modifiers.get(j);
1890            if (siTemp.getModifierString() != null) {
1891                tiTemp.setModifierString(siTemp.getModifierString());
1892                tiTemp.setModifierStringPosition(siTemp.getModifierStringPosition());
1893                tiTemp.setModifierStringAngle(siTemp.getModifierStringAngle());
1894                tiList.add(tiTemp);
1895            }
1896        }
1897        si = new SymbolInfo(tiList, liList);
1898        return si;
1899    }

1901    /**
1902     * Populates a symbol with the modifiers from a JSON string. This function
1903     * will overwrite any previously populated modifier data.
1904     *
1905     * @param saModifiers a JSON formatted string containing all the symbol
1906     * modifier data.
1907     * @param saAttributes a JSON formatted string containing all the symbol
1908     * attribute data.
1909     * @param symbol An existing MilStdSymbol
1910     * @return
1911     */
1912    private static boolean populateModifiers(SparseArray<String> saModifiers, SparseArray<String> saAttributes, MilStdSymbol symbol) {
1913        SparseArray<String> modifiers = new SparseArray<String>();
1914        SparseArray<String> attributes = saAttributes.clone();
1915
1916        // Stores array graphic modifiers for MilStdSymbol;
1917        ArrayList<Double> altitudes = null;
1918        ArrayList<Double> azimuths = null;
1919        ArrayList<Double> distances = null;
1920
1921        // Stores colors for symbol.
1922        String fillColor = null;
1923        String lineColor = null;
1924        String textColor = null;
1925        String textBackgroundColor = null;
1926
1927        int lineWidth = 0;
1928        int symstd = 0;
1929        String altMode = null;
1930        boolean useDashArray = symbol.getUseDashArray();
1931        boolean usePatternFill = symbol.getUseFillPattern();
1932        int patternFillType = 0;
1933        boolean hideOptionalLabels = false;
1934        DistanceUnit distanceUnit = null;
1935        DistanceUnit altitudeUnit = null;
1936
1937        String symbolFillIDs = null;
1938        String symbolFillIconSize = null;
1939
1940        try {
1941
1942            // The following attirubtes are labels.  All of them
1943            // are strings and can be added on the creation of the
1944            // MilStdSymbol by adding to a Map and passing in the
1945            // modifiers parameter.
1946            if (saModifiers != null) {
1947                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.C_QUANTITY) >= 0) {
1948                    modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.C_QUANTITY, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.C_QUANTITY)));
1949                }
1950
1951                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.H_ADDITIONAL_INFO_1) >= 0) {
1952                    modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.H_ADDITIONAL_INFO_1, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.H_ADDITIONAL_INFO_1)));
1953                }
1954
1955                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.H1_ADDITIONAL_INFO_2) >= 0) {
1956                    modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.H1_ADDITIONAL_INFO_2, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.H1_ADDITIONAL_INFO_2)));
1957                }
1958
1959                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.H2_ADDITIONAL_INFO_3) >= 0) {
1960                    modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.H2_ADDITIONAL_INFO_3, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.H2_ADDITIONAL_INFO_3)));
1961                }
1962
1963                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.N_HOSTILE) >= 0) {
1964                    modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.N_HOSTILE, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.N_HOSTILE)));
1965                }
1966
1967                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.Q_DIRECTION_OF_MOVEMENT) >= 0) {
1968                    modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.Q_DIRECTION_OF_MOVEMENT, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.Q_DIRECTION_OF_MOVEMENT)));
1969                }
1970
1971                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.T_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_1) >= 0) {
1972                    modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.T_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_1, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.T_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_1)));
1973                }
1974
1975                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.T1_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_2) >= 0) {
1976                    modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.T1_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_2, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.T1_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_2)));
1977                }
1978
1979                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.V_EQUIP_TYPE) >= 0) {
1980                    modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.V_EQUIP_TYPE, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.V_EQUIP_TYPE)));
1981                }
1982
1983                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.W_DTG_1) >= 0) {
1984                    modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.W_DTG_1, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.W_DTG_1)));
1985                }
1986
1987                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.W1_DTG_2) >= 0) {
1988                    modifiers.put(ModifiersTG.W1_DTG_2, String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.W1_DTG_2)));
1989                }
1990
1991                //Required multipoint modifier arrays
1992                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.X_ALTITUDE_DEPTH) >= 0) {
1993                    altitudes = new ArrayList<Double>();
1994                    String[] arrAltitudes = String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.X_ALTITUDE_DEPTH)).split(",");
1995                    for (String x : arrAltitudes) {
1996                        if (x.equals("") != true) {
1997                            altitudes.add(Double.parseDouble(x));
1998                        }
1999                    }
2000                }
2001
2002                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE) >= 0) {
2003                    distances = new ArrayList<Double>();
2004                    String[] arrDistances = String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE)).split(",");
2005                    for (String am : arrDistances) {
2006                        if (am.equals("") != true) {
2007                            distances.add(Double.parseDouble(am));
2008                        }
2009                    }
2010                }
2011
2012                if (saModifiers.indexOfKey(ModifiersTG.AN_AZIMUTH) >= 0) {
2013                    azimuths = new ArrayList<Double>();
2014                    String[] arrAzimuths = String.valueOf(saModifiers.get(ModifiersTG.AN_AZIMUTH)).split(",");;
2015                    for (String an : arrAzimuths) {
2016                        if (an.equals("") != true) {
2017                            azimuths.add(Double.parseDouble(an));
2018                        }
2019                    }
2020                }
2021            }
2022            if (saAttributes != null) {
2023                // These properties are ints, not labels, they are colors.//////////////////
2024                if (saAttributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.FillColor) >= 0) {
2025                    fillColor = (String) saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.FillColor);
2026                }
2027
2028                if (saAttributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.LineColor) >= 0) {
2029                    lineColor = (String) saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.LineColor);
2030                }
2031
2032                if (saAttributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.LineWidth) >= 0) {
2033                    lineWidth = Integer.parseInt(saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.LineWidth));
2034                }
2035                
2036                if (saAttributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.TextColor) >= 0) {
2037                    textColor = (String) saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.TextColor);
2038                }
2039                
2040                if (saAttributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.TextBackgroundColor) >= 0) {
2041                    textBackgroundColor = (String) saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.TextBackgroundColor);
2042                }
2043
2044                if (saAttributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.SymbologyStandard) >= 0) {
2045                    symstd = Integer.parseInt(saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.SymbologyStandard));
2046                    symbol.setSymbologyStandard(symstd);
2047                }
2048
2049                if (saAttributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.AltitudeMode) >= 0) {
2050                    altMode = saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.AltitudeMode);
2051                }
2052
2053                if (saAttributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.UseDashArray) >= 0) {
2054                    useDashArray = Boolean.parseBoolean(saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.UseDashArray));
2055                }
2056
2057                if (saAttributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.UsePatternFill) >= 0) {
2058                    usePatternFill = Boolean.parseBoolean(saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.UsePatternFill));
2059                }
2060
2061                if (saAttributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.PatternFillType) >= 0) {
2062                    patternFillType = Integer.parseInt((saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.PatternFillType)));
2063                }
2064
2065                if (saAttributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.HideOptionalLabels) >= 0) {
2066                    hideOptionalLabels = Boolean.parseBoolean(saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.HideOptionalLabels));
2067                }
2068
2069                if(saAttributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.AltitudeUnits) >= 0) {
2070                    altitudeUnit = DistanceUnit.parse(saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.AltitudeUnits));
2071                }
2072
2073                if(saAttributes.indexOfKey(MilStdAttributes.DistanceUnits) >= 0) {
2074                    distanceUnit = DistanceUnit.parse(saAttributes.get(MilStdAttributes.DistanceUnits));
2075                }
2076            }
2077
2078            symbol.setModifierMap(modifiers);
2079
2080            if (fillColor != null && fillColor.equals("") == false) {
2081                symbol.setFillColor(SymbolUtilities.getColorFromHexString(fillColor));
2082            } 
2083
2084            if (lineColor != null && lineColor.equals("") == false) {
2085                symbol.setLineColor(SymbolUtilities.getColorFromHexString(lineColor));
2086            }
2087            else if(symbol.getLineColor()==null)
2088                symbol.setLineColor(Color.black);
2089
2090            if (lineWidth > 0) {
2091                symbol.setLineWidth(lineWidth);
2092            }
2093            
2094            if (textColor != null && textColor.equals("") == false) {
2095                symbol.setTextColor(SymbolUtilities.getColorFromHexString(textColor));
2096            }
2097            else
2098                symbol.setTextColor(symbol.getLineColor());
2099                
2100            if (textBackgroundColor != null && textBackgroundColor.equals("") == false) {
2101                symbol.setTextBackgroundColor(SymbolUtilities.getColorFromHexString(textBackgroundColor));
2102            }
2103
2104            if (altMode != null) {
2105                symbol.setAltitudeMode(altMode);
2106            }
2107
2108            symbol.setUseDashArray(useDashArray);
2109            symbol.setUseFillPattern(usePatternFill);
2110            if(SymbolUtilities.isBasicShape(symbol.getSymbolID()))
2111                symbol.setPatternFillType(patternFillType);
2112            symbol.setHideOptionalLabels(hideOptionalLabels);
2113            symbol.setAltitudeUnit(altitudeUnit);
2114            symbol.setDistanceUnit(distanceUnit);
2115
2116            // Check grpahic modifiers variables.  If we set earlier, populate
2117            // the fields, otherwise, ignore.
2118            if (altitudes != null) {
2119                symbol.setModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.X_ALTITUDE_DEPTH, altitudes);
2120            }
2121            if (distances != null) {
2122                symbol.setModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE, distances);
2123            }
2124
2125            if (azimuths != null) {
2126                symbol.setModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AN_AZIMUTH, azimuths);
2127            }
2128
2129            //Check if sector range fan has required min range
2130            if (SymbolUtilities.getBasicSymbolID(symbol.getSymbolID()).equals("G*F*AXS---****X")) {
2131                if (symbol.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AN_AZIMUTH) != null
2132                        && symbol.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE) != null) {
2133                    int anCount = symbol.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AN_AZIMUTH).size();
2134                    int amCount = symbol.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE).size();
2135                    ArrayList<Double> am = null;
2136                    if (amCount < ((anCount / 2) + 1)) {
2137                        am = symbol.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE);
2138                        if (am.get(0) != 0.0) {
2139                            am.add(0, 0.0);
2140                        }
2141                    }
2142                }
2143            }
2144        } catch (Exception exc2) {
2145            Log.e("MPH.populateModifiers", exc2.getMessage(), exc2);
2146        }
2147        return true;
2148
2149    }

2354    private static String KMLize(String id, String name,
2355            String description,
2356            String symbolCode,
2357            ArrayList<ShapeInfo> shapes,
2358            ArrayList<ShapeInfo> modifiers,
2359            IPointConversion ipc,
2360            boolean normalize,
2361            Color textColor,
2362            boolean wasClipped, int textScaleSensitive, int symbolScaleSensitive) {
2363
2364        java.lang.StringBuilder kml = new java.lang.StringBuilder();
2365
2366        ShapeInfo tempModifier = null;
2367
2368        String cdataStart = "<![CDATA[";
2369        String cdataEnd = "]]>";
2370
2371        int len = shapes.size();
2372        kml.append("<Folder id=\"").append(id).append("\">");
2373        kml.append("<name>").append(cdataStart).append(name).append(cdataEnd).append("</name>");
2374        kml.append("<visibility>1</visibility>");
2375        kml.append("<description>").append(cdataStart).append(description).append(cdataEnd).append("</description>");
2376        kml.append("<ExtendedData>");
2377        kml.append("<Data name=\"symbolID\"><value>").append(symbolCode).append("</value></Data>");
2378        kml.append("<Data name=\"wasClipped\"><value>").append(wasClipped).append("</value></Data>");
2379        kml.append("<Data name=\"textScaleSensitive\"><value>").append(textScaleSensitive).append("</value></Data>");
2380        kml.append("<Data name=\"symbolScaleSensitive\"><value>").append(symbolScaleSensitive).append("</value></Data>");
2381        kml.append("</ExtendedData>");
2382        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
2383
2384            String shapesToAdd = ShapeToKMLString(name, description, symbolCode, shapes.get(i), ipc, normalize);
2385            kml.append(shapesToAdd);
2386        }
2387
2388        int len2 = modifiers.size();
2389
2390        for (int j = 0; j < len2; j++) {
2391
2392            tempModifier = modifiers.get(j);
2393
2394            //if(geMap)//if using google earth
2395            //assume kml text is going to be centered
2396            //AdjustModifierPointToCenter(tempModifier);
2397
2398            String labelsToAdd = LabelToKMLString(tempModifier, ipc, normalize, textColor);
2399            kml.append(labelsToAdd);
2400        }
2401
2402        kml.append("</Folder>");
2403        return kml.toString();
2404    }

2406    /**
2407     * 
2408     * @param shapes
2409     * @param modifiers
2410     * @param ipc
2411     * @param geMap
2412     * @param normalize
2413     * @return 
2414     * @deprecated Use GeoJSONize()

2416    private static String JSONize(ArrayList<ShapeInfo> shapes, ArrayList<ShapeInfo> modifiers, IPointConversion ipc, Boolean geMap, boolean normalize) {
2417        String polygons = "";
2418        String lines = "";
2419        String labels = "";
2420        String jstr = "";
2421        ShapeInfo tempModifier = null;
2422
2423        int len = shapes.size();
2424        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
2425            if (jstr.length() > 0) {
2426                jstr += ",";
2427            }
2428            String shapesToAdd = ShapeToJSONString(shapes.get(i), ipc, geMap, normalize);
2429            if (shapesToAdd.length() > 0) {
2430                if (shapesToAdd.startsWith("line", 2)) {
2431                    if (lines.length() > 0) {
2432                        lines += ",";
2433                    }
2434
2435                    lines += shapesToAdd;
2436                } else if (shapesToAdd.startsWith("polygon", 2)) {
2437                    if (polygons.length() > 0) {
2438                        polygons += ",";
2439                    }
2440
2441                    polygons += shapesToAdd;
2442                }
2443            }
2444        }
2445
2446        jstr += "\"polygons\": [" + polygons + "],"
2447                + "\"lines\": [" + lines + "],";
2448        int len2 = modifiers.size();
2449        labels = "";
2450        for (int j = 0; j < len2; j++) {
2451            tempModifier = modifiers.get(j);
2452            if (geMap) {
2453                AdjustModifierPointToCenter(tempModifier);
2454            }
2455            String labelsToAdd = LabelToJSONString(tempModifier, ipc, normalize);
2456            if (labelsToAdd.length() > 0) {
2457                if (labels.length() > 0) {
2458                    labels += ",";
2459                }
2460
2461                labels += labelsToAdd;
2462
2463            }
2464        }
2465        jstr += "\"labels\": [" + labels + "]";
2466        return jstr;
2467    }

2469    private static Color getIdealTextBackgroundColor(Color fgColor) {
2470        //ErrorLogger.LogMessage("SymbolDraw","getIdealtextBGColor", "in function", Level.SEVERE);
2471        try {
2472            //an array of three elements containing the
2473            //hue, saturation, and brightness (in that order),
2474            //of the color with the indicated red, green, and blue components/
2475            float hsbvals[] = new float[3];
2476
2477            if (fgColor != null) {/*
2478                 Color.RGBtoHSB(fgColor.getRed(), fgColor.getGreen(), fgColor.getBlue(), hsbvals);
2479
2480                 if(hsbvals != null)
2481                 {
2482                 //ErrorLogger.LogMessage("SymbolDraw","getIdealtextBGColor", "length: " + String.valueOf(hsbvals.length));
2483                 //ErrorLogger.LogMessage("SymbolDraw","getIdealtextBGColor", "H: " + String.valueOf(hsbvals[0]) + " S: " + String.valueOf(hsbvals[1]) + " B: " + String.valueOf(hsbvals[2]),Level.SEVERE);
2484                 if(hsbvals[2] > 0.6)
2485                 return Color.BLACK;
2486                 else
2487                 return Color.WHITE;
2488                 }*/
2489
2490                int nThreshold = RendererSettings.getInstance().getTextBackgroundAutoColorThreshold();//160;
2491                int bgDelta = (int) ((fgColor.getRed() * 0.299) + (fgColor.getGreen() * 0.587) + (fgColor.getBlue() * 0.114));
2492                //ErrorLogger.LogMessage("bgDelta: " + String.valueOf(255-bgDelta));
2493                //if less than threshold, black, otherwise white.
2494                //return (255 - bgDelta < nThreshold) ? Color.BLACK : Color.WHITE;//new Color(0, 0, 0, fgColor.getAlpha())
2495                return (255 - bgDelta < nThreshold) ? new Color(0, 0, 0, fgColor.getAlpha()) : new Color(255, 255, 255, fgColor.getAlpha());
2496            }
2497        } catch (Exception exc) {
2498            ErrorLogger.LogException("SymbolDraw", "getIdealtextBGColor", exc);
2499        }
2500        return Color.WHITE;
2501    }

2503    private static String LabelToGeoJSONString(ShapeInfo shapeInfo, IPointConversion ipc, boolean normalize, Color textColor, Color textBackgroundColor) {
2504
2505        StringBuilder JSONed = new StringBuilder();
2506        StringBuilder properties = new StringBuilder();
2507        StringBuilder geometry = new StringBuilder();
2508
2509        Color outlineColor = getIdealTextBackgroundColor(textColor);
2510        if(textBackgroundColor != null)
2511                outlineColor = textBackgroundColor;
2512
2513        //AffineTransform at = shapeInfo.getAffineTransform();
2514        //Point2D coord = (Point2D)new Point2D.Double(at.getTranslateX(), at.getTranslateY());
2515        //Point2D coord = (Point2D) new Point2D.Double(shapeInfo.getGlyphPosition().getX(), shapeInfo.getGlyphPosition().getY());

2517        Point2D geoCoord = ipc.PixelsToGeo(coord);
2518        //M. Deutch 9-27-11
2519        if (normalize) {
2520            geoCoord = NormalizeCoordToGECoord(geoCoord);
2521        }
2522        double latitude = Math.round(geoCoord.getY() * 100000000.0) / 100000000.0;
2523        double longitude = Math.round(geoCoord.getX() * 100000000.0) / 100000000.0;
2524        double angle = shapeInfo.getModifierStringAngle();
2525        coord.setLocation(longitude, latitude);
2526
2527        //diagnostic M. Deutch 10-18-11
2528        shapeInfo.setGlyphPosition(coord);
2529
2530        String text = shapeInfo.getModifierString();
2531        
2532        int justify=shapeInfo.getTextJustify();
2533        String strJustify="left";

2535            strJustify="left";
2536        else if(justify==1)
2537            strJustify="center";
2538        else if(justify==2)
2539            strJustify="right";
2540
2541        
2542        RendererSettings RS = RendererSettings.getInstance();
2543
2544        if (text != null && text.equals("") == false) {
2545
2546            JSONed.append("{\"type\":\"Feature\",\"properties\":{\"label\":\"");
2547            JSONed.append(text);
2548            JSONed.append("\",\"pointRadius\":0,\"fontColor\":\"");
2549            JSONed.append(SymbolUtilities.colorToHexString(textColor, false));
2550            JSONed.append("\",\"fontSize\":\"");

2552            JSONed.append(",\"fontFamily\":\"");
2553            JSONed.append(RS.getMPModifierFontName());
2554            JSONed.append(", sans-serif");
2555
2556            if (RS.getMPModifierFontType() == Typeface.BOLD) {
2557                JSONed.append("\",\"fontWeight\":\"bold\"");
2558            } else {
2559                JSONed.append("\",\"fontWeight\":\"normal\"");
2560            }
2561
2562            //JSONed.append(",\"labelAlign\":\"lm\"");
2563            JSONed.append(",\"labelAlign\":\"");
2564            JSONed.append(strJustify);
2565            JSONed.append("\",\"labelBaseline\":\"alphabetic\"");
2566            JSONed.append(",\"labelXOffset\":0");
2567            JSONed.append(",\"labelYOffset\":0");
2568            JSONed.append(",\"labelOutlineColor\":\"");
2569            JSONed.append(SymbolUtilities.colorToHexString(outlineColor, false));
2570            JSONed.append("\",\"labelOutlineWidth\":");
2571            JSONed.append("4");
2572            JSONed.append(",\"rotation\":");

2574            JSONed.append(",\"angle\":");
2575            JSONed.append(angle);
2576            JSONed.append("},");
2577
2578            JSONed.append("\"geometry\":{\"type\":\"Point\",\"coordinates\":[");
2579            JSONed.append(longitude);
2580            JSONed.append(",");
2581            JSONed.append(latitude);
2582            JSONed.append("]");
2583            JSONed.append("}}");
2584
2585        } else {
2586            return "";
2587        }
2588
2589        return JSONed.toString();

2592    private static String ShapeToGeoJSONString(ShapeInfo shapeInfo, IPointConversion ipc, boolean normalize) {
2593        StringBuilder JSONed = new StringBuilder();
2594        StringBuilder properties = new StringBuilder();
2595        StringBuilder geometry = new StringBuilder();
2596        String geometryType = null;
2597        /*
2598         NOTE: Google Earth / KML colors are backwards.
2599         They are ordered Alpha,Blue,Green,Red, not Red,Green,Blue,Aplha like the rest of the world
2600         * */
2601        Color lineColor = shapeInfo.getLineColor();
2602        Color fillColor = shapeInfo.getFillColor();
2603
2604        if (shapeInfo.getShapeType() == ShapeInfo.SHAPE_TYPE_FILL || fillColor != null) {
2605            geometryType = "\"Polygon\"";
2606        } else //if(shapeInfo.getShapeType() == ShapeInfo.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE)
2607        {
2608            geometryType = "\"MultiLineString\"";
2609        }
2610
2611        BasicStroke stroke = null;
2612        stroke = (BasicStroke) shapeInfo.getStroke();
2613        int lineWidth = 4;
2614
2615        if (stroke != null) {
2616            lineWidth = (int) stroke.getLineWidth();
2617            //lineWidth++;
2618            //System.out.println("lineWidth: " + String.valueOf(lineWidth));
2619        }
2620
2621        //generate JSON properties for feature
2622        properties.append("\"properties\":{");
2623        properties.append("\"label\":\"\",");
2624        if (lineColor != null) {
2625            properties.append("\"strokeColor\":\"" + SymbolUtilities.colorToHexString(lineColor, false) + "\",");
2626            properties.append("\"lineOpacity\":" + String.valueOf(lineColor.getAlpha() / 255f) + ",");
2627        }
2628        if (fillColor != null) {
2629            properties.append("\"fillColor\":\"" + SymbolUtilities.colorToHexString(fillColor, false) + "\",");
2630            properties.append("\"fillOpacity\":" + String.valueOf(fillColor.getAlpha() / 255f) + ",");
2631        }
2632        String strokeWidth = String.valueOf(lineWidth);
2633        properties.append("\"strokeWidth\":" + strokeWidth + ",");
2634        properties.append("\"strokeWeight\":" + strokeWidth + "");
2635        properties.append("}");
2636
2637        //generate JSON geometry for feature
2638        geometry.append("\"geometry\":{\"type\":");
2639        geometry.append(geometryType);
2640        geometry.append(",\"coordinates\":[");
2641
2642        ArrayList shapesArray = shapeInfo.getPolylines();
2643
2644        for (int i = 0; i < shapesArray.size(); i++) {
2645            ArrayList pointList = (ArrayList) shapesArray.get(i);
2646
2647            normalize = normalizePoints(pointList, ipc);
2648
2649            geometry.append("[");
2650
2651            //System.out.println("Pixel Coords:");
2652            for (int j = 0; j < pointList.size(); j++) {
2653                Point2D coord = (Point2D) pointList.get(j);
2654                Point2D geoCoord = ipc.PixelsToGeo(coord);
2655                //M. Deutch 9-27-11
2656                if (normalize) {
2657                    geoCoord = NormalizeCoordToGECoord(geoCoord);
2658                }
2659                double latitude = Math.round(geoCoord.getY() * 100000000.0) / 100000000.0;
2660                double longitude = Math.round(geoCoord.getX() * 100000000.0) / 100000000.0;
2661
2662                //fix for fill crossing DTL
2663                if (normalize && fillColor != null) {
2664                    if (longitude > 0) {
2665                        longitude -= 360;
2666                    }
2667                }
2668
2669                //diagnostic M. Deutch 10-18-11
2670                //set the point as geo so that the 
2671                //coord.setLocation(longitude, latitude);
2672                coord = new Point2D.Double(longitude, latitude);
2673                pointList.set(j, coord);
2674                //end section
2675
2676                geometry.append("[");
2677                geometry.append(longitude);
2678                geometry.append(",");
2679                geometry.append(latitude);
2680                geometry.append("]");
2681
2682                if (j < (pointList.size() - 1)) {
2683                    geometry.append(",");
2684                }
2685            }
2686
2687            geometry.append("]");
2688
2689            if (i < (shapesArray.size() - 1)) {
2690                geometry.append(",");
2691            }
2692        }
2693        geometry.append("]}");
2694
2695        JSONed.append("{\"type\":\"Feature\",");
2696        JSONed.append(properties.toString());
2697        JSONed.append(",");
2698        JSONed.append(geometry.toString());
2699        JSONed.append("}");
2700
2701        return JSONed.toString();
2702    }

2704    protected static String bitmapToString(Bitmap bitmap) {
2705        final int COMPRESSION_QUALITY = 100;
2706        String encodedImage;
2707        ByteArrayOutputStream byteArrayBitmapStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
2708        bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, COMPRESSION_QUALITY,
2709                byteArrayBitmapStream);
2710        byte[] b = byteArrayBitmapStream.toByteArray();
2711        encodedImage = Base64.encodeToString(b, Base64.DEFAULT);
2712        return "data:image/png;base64," + encodedImage;
2713    }

2715    private static String GeoJSONize(ArrayList<ShapeInfo> shapes, ArrayList<ShapeInfo> modifiers, IPointConversion ipc, boolean normalize, Color textColor, Color textBackgroundColor) {
2716
2717        String jstr = "";
2718        ShapeInfo tempModifier = null;
2719        StringBuilder fc = new StringBuilder();//JSON feature collection
2720
2721        fc.append("[");
2722
2723        int len = shapes.size();
2724        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
2725
2726            String shapesToAdd = ShapeToGeoJSONString(shapes.get(i), ipc, normalize);
2727            if (shapesToAdd.length() > 0) {
2728                fc.append(shapesToAdd);
2729            }
2730            if (i < len - 1) {
2731                fc.append(",");
2732            }
2733        }
2734
2735        int len2 = modifiers.size();
2736
2737        for (int j = 0; j < len2; j++) {
2738            tempModifier = modifiers.get(j);
2739
2740            String labelsToAdd = LabelToGeoJSONString(tempModifier, ipc, normalize, textColor, textBackgroundColor);
2741            if (labelsToAdd.length() > 0) {
2742                fc.append(",");
2743                fc.append(labelsToAdd);
2744            }
2745        }
2746        fc.append("]");
2747        String GeoJSON = fc.toString();
2748        return GeoJSON;
2749    }

2751    /**
2752     *
2753     * @param urlImage
2754     * @param ipc
2755     * @param symbolBounds
2756     * @param normalize
2757     * @return
2758     */
2759    private static String GenerateGroundOverlayKML(
2760            String urlImage, IPointConversion ipc,
2761            Rectangle symbolBounds,
2762            boolean normalize)//, ArrayList<ShapeInfo> shapes)
2763    {
2764        //int shapeType = -1;
2765        double x = 0;
2766        double y = 0;
2767        double height = 0;
2768        double width = 0;
2769        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
2770        Boolean lineFill = false;
2771        Map<String, String> params = null;
2772        int symbolSize = 0;
2773        int imageOffset = 0;
2774
2775        try {
2776            //if it's a line pattern, we need to know how big the symbols
2777            //are so we can increase the size of the image.
2778            int index = -1;
2779            index = urlImage.indexOf(SYMBOL_LINE_IDS);
2780
2781            if (index > 0)//if(urlImage contains SYMBOL_LINE_IDS)
2782            {
2783                lineFill = true;
2784                if (params.containsKey(SYMBOL_FILL_ICON_SIZE)) {
2785                    String size = (String) params.get(SYMBOL_FILL_ICON_SIZE);
2786                    symbolSize = Integer.decode(size);// getInteger(size);
2787                } else {
2788                }
2789                imageOffset = (symbolSize / 2) + 3;//+3 to make room for rotation
2790            }
2791
2792            Rectangle bounds = null;
2793            bounds = symbolBounds;
2794            height = bounds.getHeight() + (imageOffset * 2);
2795            width = bounds.getWidth() + (imageOffset * 2);
2796            x = bounds.getX() - imageOffset;
2797            y = bounds.getY() - imageOffset;
2798
2799            Point2D coord = (Point2D) new Point2D.Double(x, y);
2800            Point2D topLeft = ipc.PixelsToGeo(coord);
2801            coord = (Point2D) new Point2D.Double(x + width, y + height);
2802            Point2D bottomRight = ipc.PixelsToGeo(coord);
2803
2804            if (normalize) {
2805                topLeft = NormalizeCoordToGECoord(topLeft);
2806                bottomRight = NormalizeCoordToGECoord(bottomRight);
2807            }
2808
2809            String cdataStart = "<![CDATA[";
2810            String cdataEnd = "]]>";
2811            //build kml
2812            sb.append("<GroundOverlay>");
2813            sb.append("<name>symbol fill</name>");
2814            sb.append("<description>symbol fill</description>");
2815            sb.append("<Icon>");
2816            sb.append("<href>");
2817            sb.append(cdataStart);
2818            sb.append(urlImage);
2819            sb.append(cdataEnd);
2820            sb.append("</href>");
2821            sb.append("</Icon>");
2822            sb.append("<LatLonBox>");
2823            sb.append("<north>");
2824            sb.append(String.valueOf(topLeft.getY()));
2825            sb.append("</north>");
2826            sb.append("<south>");
2827            sb.append(String.valueOf(bottomRight.getY()));
2828            sb.append("</south>");
2829            sb.append("<east>");
2830            sb.append(String.valueOf(bottomRight.getX()));
2831            sb.append("</east>");
2832            sb.append("<west>");
2833            sb.append(String.valueOf(topLeft.getX()));
2834            sb.append("</west>");
2835            sb.append("<rotation>");
2836            sb.append(0);
2837            sb.append("</rotation>");
2838            sb.append("</LatLonBox>");
2839            sb.append("</GroundOverlay>");
2840        } catch (Exception exc) {
2841            System.out.println(exc.getMessage());
2842            exc.printStackTrace();
2843        }
2844        String kml = sb.toString();
2845        return kml;
2846    }

2884    private static Boolean normalizePoints(ArrayList<Point2D.Double> shape, IPointConversion ipc) {
2885        ArrayList geoCoords = new ArrayList();
2886        int n = shape.size();
2887        //for (int j = 0; j < shape.size(); j++) 
2888        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
2889            Point2D coord = shape.get(j);
2890            Point2D geoCoord = ipc.PixelsToGeo(coord);
2891            geoCoord = NormalizeCoordToGECoord(geoCoord);
2892            double latitude = geoCoord.getY();
2893            double longitude = geoCoord.getX();
2894            Point2D pt2d = new Point2D.Double(longitude, latitude);
2895            geoCoords.add(pt2d);
2896        }
2897        Boolean normalize = crossesIDL(geoCoords);
2898        return normalize;
2899    }

2964        fillColor = shapeInfo.getFillColor();
2965        if (fillColor != null) {
2966            googleFillColor = Integer.toHexString(shapeInfo.getFillColor().toARGB());
2967
2968            googleFillColor = JavaRendererUtilities.ARGBtoABGR(googleFillColor);
2969
2970            kml.append("<PolyStyle>");
2971            kml.append("<color>" + googleFillColor + "</color>");
2972            kml.append("<colorMode>normal</colorMode>");
2973            kml.append("<fill>1</fill>");
2974            if (lineColor != null) {
2975                kml.append("<outline>1</outline>");
2976            } else {
2977                kml.append("<outline>0</outline>");
2978            }
2979            kml.append("</PolyStyle>");
2980        }
2981
2982        kml.append("</Style>");
2983
2984        ArrayList shapesArray = shapeInfo.getPolylines();
2985        int len = shapesArray.size();
2986        kml.append("<MultiGeometry>");
2987
2988        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
2989            ArrayList shape = (ArrayList) shapesArray.get(i);
2990            normalize = normalizePoints(shape, ipc);
2991            if (lineColor != null && fillColor == null) {
2992                kml.append("<LineString>");
2993                kml.append("<tessellate>1</tessellate>");
2994                kml.append("<altitudeMode>clampToGround</altitudeMode>");
2995                kml.append("<coordinates>");
2996                int n = shape.size();
2997                //for (int j = 0; j < shape.size(); j++) 
2998                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
2999                    Point2D coord = (Point2D) shape.get(j);
3000                    Point2D geoCoord = ipc.PixelsToGeo(coord);
3001                    if (normalize) {
3002                        geoCoord = NormalizeCoordToGECoord(geoCoord);
3003                    }
3004
3005                    double latitude = Math.round(geoCoord.getY() * 100000000.0) / 100000000.0;
3006                    double longitude = Math.round(geoCoord.getX() * 100000000.0) / 100000000.0;
3007
3008                    kml.append(longitude);
3009                    kml.append(",");
3010                    kml.append(latitude);
3011                    if(j<shape.size()-1)
3012                        kml.append(" ");
3013                }
3014
3015                kml.append("</coordinates>");
3016                kml.append("</LineString>");
3017            }
3018
3019            if (fillColor != null) {
3020
3021                if (i == 0) {
3022                    kml.append("<Polygon>");
3023                }
3024                //kml.append("<outerBoundaryIs>");
3025                if (i == 1 && len > 1) {
3026                    kml.append("<innerBoundaryIs>");
3027                } else {
3028                    kml.append("<outerBoundaryIs>");
3029                }
3030                kml.append("<LinearRing>");
3031                kml.append("<altitudeMode>clampToGround</altitudeMode>");
3032                kml.append("<tessellate>1</tessellate>");
3033                kml.append("<coordinates>");
3034
3035                //this section is a workaround for a google earth bug. Issue 417 was closed
3036                //for linestrings but they did not fix the smae issue for fills. If Google fixes the issue
3037                //for fills then this section will need to be commented or it will induce an error.
3038                double lastLongitude = Double.MIN_VALUE;
3039                if (normalize == false && IsOnePointSymbolCode(symbolCode)) {
3040                    int n = shape.size();
3041                    //for (int j = 0; j < shape.size(); j++) 
3042                    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
3043                        Point2D coord = (Point2D) shape.get(j);
3044                        Point2D geoCoord = ipc.PixelsToGeo(coord);
3045                        double longitude = geoCoord.getX();
3046                        if (lastLongitude != Double.MIN_VALUE) {
3047                            if (Math.abs(longitude - lastLongitude) > 180d) {
3048                                normalize = true;
3049                                break;
3050                            }
3051                        }
3052                        lastLongitude = longitude;
3053                    }
3054                }
3055                int n = shape.size();
3056                //for (int j = 0; j < shape.size(); j++) 
3057                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
3058                    Point2D coord = (Point2D) shape.get(j);
3059                    Point2D geoCoord = ipc.PixelsToGeo(coord);
3060
3061                    double latitude = Math.round(geoCoord.getY() * 100000000.0) / 100000000.0;
3062                    double longitude = Math.round(geoCoord.getX() * 100000000.0) / 100000000.0;
3063
3064                    //fix for fill crossing DTL
3065                    if (normalize) {
3066                        if (longitude > 0) {
3067                            longitude -= 360;
3068                        }
3069                    }
3070
3071                    kml.append(longitude);
3072                    kml.append(",");
3073                    kml.append(latitude);
3074                    if(j<shape.size()-1)
3075                        kml.append(" ");
3076                }
3077
3078                kml.append("</coordinates>");
3079                kml.append("</LinearRing>");
3080                if (i == 1 && len > 1) {
3081                    kml.append("</innerBoundaryIs>");
3082                } else {
3083                    kml.append("</outerBoundaryIs>");
3084                }
3085                if (i == len - 1) {
3086                    kml.append("</Polygon>");
3087                }
3088            }
3089        }
3090
3091        kml.append("</MultiGeometry>");
3092        kml.append("</Placemark>");
3093
3094        return kml.toString();
3095    }

3413    static String canRenderMultiPoint(MilStdSymbol symbol) {
3414        int symStd = symbol.getSymbologyStandard();
3415        String symbolID = symbol.getSymbolID();
3416        String basicID = SymbolUtilities.getBasicSymbolID(symbolID);
3417        SymbolDef sd = null;
3418        int dc = 99;
3419        int coordCount = symbol.getCoordinates().size();
3420
3421        try {
3422
3423            String message = "";
3424            if (SymbolDefTable.getInstance().HasSymbolDef(basicID, symStd)) {
3425                sd = SymbolDefTable.getInstance().getSymbolDef(basicID, symStd);
3426            }
3427
3428            if (sd != null) {
3429                dc = sd.getDrawCategory();
3430                if (coordCount < sd.getMinPoints()) {
3431                    message = ("symbolID: \"" + symbolID + "\" requires a minimum of " + String.valueOf(sd.getMinPoints()) + " points. " + String.valueOf(coordCount) + " are present.");
3432                    return message;
3433                }
3434            } else if (symbolID.startsWith("BS_")) {
3435                //Will need to be updated to do a more thorough check for
3436                //basic shapes and buffered basic shapes.
3437                //Return true for now.
3438                return "true";
3439            }
3440                        else if (symbolID.startsWith("BBS_")) {
3441                ArrayList<Double> AM = symbol.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE);
3442                if(AM != null && AM.size() > 0 && AM.get(0) >= 0)
3443                        return "true";
3444                else
3445                        return "false: Buffered Basic Shapes require a width (AM)";
3446            } 
3447                        else if (symbolID.startsWith("PBS_")) 
3448                        {
3449                ArrayList<Double> AM = symbol.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE);
3450                                
3451                                if(symbolID.equals("PBS_CIRCLE-----") || symbolID.equals("PBS_SQUARE-----"))
3452                {
3453                    if (AM != null && AM.size() > 0 && coordCount > 0)
3454                    {
3455                        return "true";
3456                    }
3457                    else
3458                    {
3459                        return ("false: " + symbolID + ", requires a width (AM) and 1 control point");
3460                    }
3461                }
3462                else if(symbolID.equals("PBS_ELLIPSE----") || symbolID.equals("PBS_RECTANGLE--"))
3463                {
3464                    if (AM != null && AM.size() > 1 && coordCount > 0)
3465                    {
3466                        return "true";
3467                    }
3468                    else
3469                    {
3470                        return ("false: " + symbolID + ", requires 2 AM values, length and width (AM) and 1 control point");
3471                    }
3472                }
3473                                else
3474                                {
3475                                        return ("false: " + symbolID + ", not a recognized code for a parametered basic shape.");
3476                                }
3477            }
3478                        else {
3479                return ("symbolID: \"" + symbolID + "\" not recognized.");
3480            }
3481
3482            //now check for required modifiers\
3483            ArrayList<Double> AM = symbol.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AM_DISTANCE);
3484            ArrayList<Double> AN = symbol.getModifiers_AM_AN_X(ModifiersTG.AN_AZIMUTH);
3485            String result = hasRequiredModifiers(symbolID, dc, AM, AN);
3486
3487            if (result.equals("true") == false) {
3488                return result;
3489            } else {
3490                return "true";
3491            }
3492        } catch (Exception exc) {
3493            ErrorLogger.LogException("MultiPointHandler", "canRenderMultiPoint", exc);
3494            return "true";
3495        }
3496    }
3497    static private String AddImageFillToKML(ArrayList<POINT2> tgPoints,
3498            String jsonContent, SparseArray symbolModifiers, IPointConversion ipc, Boolean normalize)  //symbolModifiers was MilStdSymbol mSymbol
3499    {
3500        if(tgPoints==null || tgPoints.size()==0)
3501            return null;
3502        //get original point values in pixel form                    
3503        ArrayList<Point2D> pixelPoints = new ArrayList<Point2D>();
3504        //Path2D path = new Path2D.Double();
3505        GeneralPath path = new GeneralPath();
3506
3507        //for(JavaLineArray.POINT2 pt : tgPoints)
3508        int kcount = tgPoints.size();
3509        POINT2 tpTemp = null;
3510        for(int k = 0; k < kcount;k++)
3511        {
3512            tpTemp = tgPoints.get(k);
3513            pixelPoints.add(new Point2D.Double(tpTemp.x, tpTemp.y));
3514            if(k>0)
3515            {
3516                path.lineTo(tpTemp.x, tpTemp.y);
3517            }
3518            else
3519            {
3520                path.moveTo(tpTemp.x, tpTemp.y);
3521            }
3522        }
3523        Rectangle rect = path.getBounds();
3524        //get url for the fill or line pattern PNG
3525        //String goImageUrl = SECWebRenderer.GenerateSymbolLineFillUrl(mSymbol.getModifierMap(), pixelPoints,rect);
3526        String goImageUrl = SECWebRenderer.GenerateSymbolLineFillUrl(symbolModifiers, pixelPoints,rect);
3527        //generate the extra KML needed to insert the image
3528        String goKML = GenerateGroundOverlayKML(goImageUrl,ipc,rect,normalize);
3529        goKML += "</Folder>";
3530
3531        //StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
3532        //sb.replace(start, end, str)
3533        jsonContent = jsonContent.replace("</Folder>", goKML);
3534        
3535        return jsonContent;
3536    }

3538    static private String hasRequiredModifiers(String symbolID, int dc, ArrayList<Double> AM, ArrayList<Double> AN) {
3539
3540        String message = symbolID;
3541        try {
3542            if ((dc >= 16 && dc <= 20)) {
3543                if (dc == SymbolDef.DRAW_CATEGORY_CIRCULAR_PARAMETERED_AUTOSHAPE)//16
3544                {
3545                    if (AM != null && AM.size() > 0) {
3546                        return "true";
3547                    } else {
3548                        message += " requires a modifiers object that has 1 distance/AM value.";
3549                        return message;
3550                    }
3551                } else if (dc == SymbolDef.DRAW_CATEGORY_RECTANGULAR_PARAMETERED_AUTOSHAPE)//17
3552                {
3553                    if (AM != null && AM.size() >= 2
3554                            && AN != null && AN.size() >= 1) {
3555                        return "true";
3556                    } else {
3557                        message += (" requires a modifiers object that has 2 distance/AM values and 1 azimuth/AN value.");
3558                        return message;
3559                    }
3560                } else if (dc == SymbolDef.DRAW_CATEGORY_SECTOR_PARAMETERED_AUTOSHAPE)//18
3561                {
3562                    if (AM != null && AM.size() >= 2
3563                            && AN != null && AN.size() >= 2) {
3564                        return "true";
3565                    } else {
3566                        message += (" requires a modifiers object that has 2 distance/AM values and 2 azimuth/AN values per sector.  The first sector can have just one AM value although it is recommended to always use 2 values for each sector.");
3567                        return message;
3568                    }
3569                } else if (dc == SymbolDef.DRAW_CATEGORY_CIRCULAR_RANGEFAN_AUTOSHAPE)//19
3570                {
3571                    if (AM != null && AM.size() > 0) {
3572                        return "true";
3573                    } else {
3574                        message += (" requires a modifiers object that has at least 1 distance/AM value");
3575                        return message;
3576                    }
3577                } else if (dc == SymbolDef.DRAW_CATEGORY_TWO_POINT_RECT_PARAMETERED_AUTOSHAPE)//20
3578                {
3579                    if (AM != null && AM.size() > 0) {
3580                        return "true";
3581                    } else {
3582                        message += (" requires a modifiers object that has 1 distance/AM value.");
3583                        return message;
3584                    }
3585                } else {
3586                    //should never get here
3587                    return "true";
3588                }
3589            } else {
3590                //no required parameters
3591                return "true";
3592            }
3593        } catch (Exception exc) {
3594            ErrorLogger.LogException("MultiPointHandler", "hasRequiredModifiers", exc);
3595            return "true";
3596        }
3597    }
3598}
